Superb Indian Cousine
Jan 2024 • Couples
Came across Shanti indian restaurant at the food market stalls. Me and my partner both had a super delicious meal. On the way to our accommodation, we spotted the restaurant close too. The following day, we decided to go with an indian dinner again. Not that we ever repeat the same cousine twice, but as we both kept on about how tasty the previous dinner was.... 
And it did not disappoint. The service was very friendly too. We also tried the 'lucky sweet', which I can highly recommend.

To avoid
Jan 2024 • Couples
We went there based on the Tripadvisor ranking and the price. But nothing is fair.

We waited 15 minutes only to be told that we would have to wait another 25 minutes to be served. We are leaving again.

We still ate an garlic no.

Terrible service, even if the staff was nice.

Furthermore, it is completely wrong to classify it as a cheap restaurant. Count on Eur 12-15 EUR for two people, which is not a bargain here in Vietnam.
